entities.name: Vanja Marinković
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vanja Marinković is a Serbian professional basketball player and the team captain for Partizan Belgrade of the Basketball League of Serbia (KLS), the ABA League and the EuroLeague. Standing at 1.99 m, he plays at the shooting guard and small forward positions.
